intent.symptom_summary: Raw-mode hand-rolled code editor (inline in BodyEditor) is crooked: gutter line numbers drift out of alignment with code lines, accumulating downward
intent.desired_summary: Extract editor into standalone reusable CodeEditor; pin ONE absolute line-box height (20.625px) across textarea, pre, and gutter rows (never 1.65em on gutter); keep overlay mechanism (transparent textarea over aria-hidden highlighted pre, single scroll container); extract JSON tokenizer to reusable lib. Gutter numbers stay aligned to code rows at any line count
intent.verbatim_prompt: Fix and extract the raw-mode code editor in the request body editor. Symptom: the hand-rolled code editor (currently inline in BodyEditor) is crooked -- gutter line numbers drift out of alignment with code lines, accumulating downward. Root cause (confirmed in the reference CSS): gutter font-size is 11.5px with `.gutter > div { height: calc(1.65em) }` = 18.975px per row, while the <pre> lines are 12.5px * line-height 1.65 = 20.625px per row -- a per-line mismatch that compounds. Desired: extract the editor out of BodyEditor into a standalone reusable CodeEditor component and reimplement clean; pin ONE absolute line-box height (20.625px) across textarea, pre, and gutter rows (never 1.65em on the gutter); keep the overlay edit mechanism (transparent textarea over aria-hidden highlighted pre, single scroll container) -- the overlay was not the defect, the alignment math was. Extract the JSON syntax tokenizer to a reusable lib (second consumer: response-body). Preserve unchanged: JSON-only .tk-* vocabulary, {{var}}-in-string tie-break (var wins inside JSON strings), malformed JSON degrades to plain var(--text) with no throw, XSS-safe escaped-children render, fidelity asserted from a live-renderer computed-style channel (UNVERIFIED not PASS when absent). Scope: the raw code editor + its tokenizer; BodyEditor raw slot becomes a consumer. Unchanged behavior: none/urlencoded modes, the mode strip, and the token color/grid/gutter contract values (re-verified UNCHANGED vs T7a).

constraints.content: Minimal changes / never modify outside scope (Key Rules #3, Never #5)

risks.risk: Overlay pixel-grid alignment (textarea over pre) is fidelity-sensitive; the shared line-box refactor could shift row height if the var value differs from 20.625px. Mount-all hidden-panel scroll preservation and the AC-23 debounce split must survive the move

plan_seeds.recommended_approach_summary: This approach uniquely satisfies the ticket's literal instruction to pin ONE absolute line-box measure across all three layers of the editor — the number strip, the highlight layer, and the input layer — where the current build fixes only the number strip via a duplicated hardcoded literal. It REUSES the exported canonical highlighter at src/renderer/src/lib/jsonTokens.ts:344 (compose()) rather than writing a new one, so the .tk-* palette, {{var}} precedence inside strings, malformed-input degrade-to-plain (AC-17), and XSS-safe escaped-children output are preserved by construction and unchanged_behavior holds. It also removes the reuse fragility (tokens.css defines no single line-box source at present) before another call site is added. Acknowledged uncertainty: the fidelity contract is proven from a live-renderer computed-style channel, so the refactor must be re-checked UNVERIFIED-not-PASS to confirm zero visual movement.

alternatives_considered.summary: Move the raw-editor markup, state, and CSS as-is into a new CodeEditor component including the current hardcoded calc(12.5px*1.65) gutter literal; BodyEditor consumes it. No token de-duplication.
